name: Chaos Communication Congress (CCC)
description: Largest hacker association in Europe. Annual Congress (37C3, 38C3, etc.) focuses on technology, society, and civil rights. All presentations recorded on media.ccc.de.

peerReview.processDescription: Call for Participation for talks, art, music, and self-organized sessions. Content curation team reviews submissions. Focus on technical, social, and political topics. Community-driven selection.

attribution.attributionNotes: Speaker recognition in community. Published recordings with wide reach on media.ccc.de. Community credibility. Global visibility.

povsAlignment.description: Community conference with content curation team review and open access recordings.
